signals.label: Cash-flow conversion
signals.detail: FY2025 operating cash flow ₹7.9 Cr is 89% of reported profit ₹8.9 Cr.
signals.whyItMatters: Profit not backed by cash is the first thing a reviewer questions, it can signal aggressive revenue recognition or uncollected sales.
signals.prepare: Prepare a receivables ageing schedule and a collection plan; an auditor comfort note on cash conversion helps.

signals.label: Receivables vs revenue growth
signals.detail: Receivables grew 42% while revenue grew 29% in FY2025.
signals.whyItMatters: Receivables outrunning sales suggests channel-stuffing or softer-quality revenue booked before collection.
signals.prepare: Disclose any change in credit terms, provide a top-10 debtor ageing, and add a receivables risk factor.

signals.label: Pre-IPO margin expansion
signals.detail: EBITDA margin moved from 14.4% to 15.3% (+0.9 pts) into FY2025.
signals.whyItMatters: A margin that expands sharply just before an IPO is a textbook dressing-up pattern reviewers probe.
signals.prepare: Explain the cost or pricing changes behind the expansion with evidence (contracts, input costs, mix).

signals.label: Related-party concentration
signals.detail: 2 related-party signal(s); highest risk 74/100, Promoter group (unsecured loan) (Promoter group, lender).
signals.whyItMatters: Undisclosed or unpriced promoter-group dealings are the costliest SME disclosure defect and the strongest fund-diversion signal.
signals.prepare: Disclose each RPT with year-wise amounts, arm's-length pricing basis and audit-committee ratification.

signals.label: Use-of-proceeds specificity
signals.detail: Objects plan or issue size not defined yet.
signals.prepare: Complete the Objects Builder and issue size to test this.

signals.label: Promoter-loan repayment from proceeds
signals.detail: No promoter/related-party loan detected among the borrowings proposed for repayment.
signals.whyItMatters: Repaying promoter loans from proceeds is prohibited as indirect diversion.

signals.label: Cross-document consistency
signals.detail: Reported figures reconcile across audited books, GST records and the objects plan.
signals.whyItMatters: Numbers that differ between the books, GST returns and the objects plan are exactly what reviewers reconcile line by line.
signals.prepare: Provide auditor-certified reconciliations for each flagged item (GST-to-books, interest, reserves, working capital).

signals.label: Document authenticity
signals.detail: No PDF documents have been analysed for authenticity yet.
signals.whyItMatters: Doctored or forged supporting documents are a primary SME-IPO fraud vector.
signals.prepare: Upload the source PDFs (audited financials, bank statements) to run structural tamper forensics.

signals.label: Leading-digit (Benford) pattern
signals.detail: Leading-digit spread deviates from the natural distribution (deviation 4.2%). With 46 figures this is only indicative, but reviewers do look for over-rounded numbers.
signals.whyItMatters: Naturally occurring financial figures follow a predictable leading-digit spread; heavy deviation can indicate manually set or over-rounded numbers.
